title: primula auriculata subsp. olgae
intro: Primula auriculata subsp. olgae, commonly known as the Auricled primrose, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Primulaceae. It is a perennial herb with various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The plant exhibits therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Primula auriculata subsp. olgae include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
